hints.title: Ordered Merging by Exponents
hints.text: Both polynomial lists are strictly sorted in descending order of power. Scan both lists concurrently comparing exponent degrees.

hints.title: Exponent Comparison Cases
hints.text: When powers differ, attach the node with the larger power. When powers match, sum the coefficients.

hints.title: Dropping Zero Coefficient Terms
hints.text: If the combined coefficient is zero, discard the term and advance both pointers without adding a node to the output.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def addPoly(self, poly1: 'PolyNode', poly2: 'PolyNode') -> 'PolyNode':
        dummy = PolyNode()
        curr = dummy
        p1, p2 = poly1, poly2
        while p1 and p2:
            if p1.power > p2.power:
                curr.next = PolyNode(p1.coefficient, p1.power)
                curr = curr.next
                p1 = p1.next
            elif p2.power > p1.power:
                curr.next = PolyNode(p2.coefficient, p2.power)
                curr = curr.next
                p2 = p2.next
            else:
                sum_coef = p1.coefficient + p2.coefficient
                if sum_coef != 0:
                    curr.next = PolyNode(sum_coef, p1.power)
                    curr = curr.next
                p1 = p1.next
                p2 = p2.next
        while p1:
            curr.next = PolyNode(p1.coefficient, p1.power)
            curr = curr.next
            p1 = p1.next
        while p2:
            curr.next = PolyNode(p2.coefficient, p2.power)
            curr = curr.next
            p2 = p2.next
        return dummy.next
```

complexity.notes: Single pass two-pointer merge over descending polynomial power sequences.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting into hash maps requires extra space and separate sorting by power.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct pointer iteration preserves existing sorting in linear time without auxiliary allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Merge routine with zero-coefficient cancellation and dummy head construction.
